responsibility: Contains the rs6000 machine-description support for the e500 SPE and related GPR-based floating-point/vector execution model. It defines scalar embedded-FP patterns, SPE vector integer and V2SF operations, comparisons, long-double sequences, and SPE ABI-specific save/restore branch patterns, mapping generic RTL and SPE builtins onto ev*/efs*/efd* instructions and the special SPE register/condition-code behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the SPE machine-description file, defining RTL patterns for the e500 SPE execution model, including GPR-based floating-point, vector operations, comparisons, and SPE ABI save/restore sequences. Unlike spe.h, it is backend code-generation data rather than a user intrinsic header.
